name: Alcaldía de Itagüí
body: A content security policy, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, and a permanent https redirect. But the ci_session_sede_electronica cookie is set without Secure, and no HSTS backs it up.
lesson: Mark every cookie Secure, and session cookies HttpOnly and SameSite. One server setting covers them all.
summary: www.itagui.gov.co scores 69 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 18 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /transparencia, /sitio/glosario, /sitio/preguntas_frecuentes and 7 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 164 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: itagui.gov.co (164). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.itagui.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: ci_session_sede_electronica, cookiesession1, csrf_9c33ef4dbe36418accefc1a31709f401_cookie. Without HttpOnly: csrf_9c33ef4dbe36418accefc1a31709f401_cookie. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /transparencia,…
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 94 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 508 ms
Every page has a meta description
